name: Beseech the Mirror
clause: Bargain / Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle. If ~ was bargained, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost if that spell's mana value is 4 or less. Put the exiled card into your hand if it wasn't cast this way.

needs.proposedSignature: Condition { kind: 'was-cast-this-way', of?: Ref }  — true when the permission a preceding `cast-free` / `play-exiled` granted in this resolution was actually used on the bound object
needs.semantics: 'Put the exiled card into your hand if it wasn't cast this way' branches on whether the optional free cast the previous sentence offered happened. `cast-free` (cost-alter) performs the cast but reports nothing, and no condition can read the outcome of an earlier effect in the same resolution, so the fall-back half of the sentence cannot be written.
needs.clause: Put the exiled card into your hand if it wasn't cast this way.

needs.proposedSignature: face declaration `bargain?: true` (an OPTIONAL additional cost: sacrifice an artifact, enchantment or token as you cast this spell), a `covers[].by` kind 'bargain' whose anchored line shape is /^bargain$/, and Condition { kind: 'bargained' }
needs.semantics: Bargain (CR 702.166a) is an optional additional cost whose payment is remembered on the spell and read back by the spell's own text ('If this spell was bargained, …'). `additionalCosts` today is an `AbilityCost` that is always paid and has no 'optional' flag, its covers shape only matches 'As an additional cost to cast ~, …', and there is no condition kind for 'was bargained' (the closest existing pair is `kicked` / Filter.kicked, which is exactly the shape bargain needs).

needs.proposedSignature: widen `search.to` to include 'exile' with `faceDown?: true`, and bind what was found as `that` / `exiled-with` so a following effect can name it: { op: 'search', filter, to: 'exile', faceDown: true, count: 1, ... }
needs.semantics: 'Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle' is a tutor whose destination is exile, which `search.to` (hand | battlefield | graveyard | top) cannot name. `impulse` exiles from the TOP of the library, not from a search, and `exile-from-hand` is the wrong zone. The found card must stay bound so the next sentence ('you may cast the exiled card…', 'Put the exiled card into your hand…') can refer to it.
needs.clause: Search your library for a card, exile it face down, then shuffle.
